key_claims: 5 (4b) [ 29 ] , to test whether broad medical specialization improves pathology visual understanding.

medical- and pathology-specialized models do not consistently outperform general-purpose mllms on pathview-bench, suggesting that domain-knowledge training must be balanced with basic visual grounding
improving coordinate-aware grounding would help extend these models to evidence navigation, lesion localization, burden estimation, and interactive review.
